def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    seed_time = pd.Timestamp(seed_time)
    if seed_time.tzinfo is not None:
        seed_time = seed_time.tz_localize(None)

    orders = db['orders']
    order_items = db['order_items']
    reviews = db['reviews']
    payments = db['payments']

    # Orders placed before seed_time
    orders_before = orders[orders['order_purchase_timestamp'] <= seed_time][
        ['order_id', 'customer_id',
         'order_delivered_carrier_date', 'order_delivered_customer_date',
         'order_estimated_delivery_date']
    ]

    items = order_items[['order_id', 'product_id', 'seller_id', 'price',
                         'freight_value', 'ts']].merge(
        orders_before, on='order_id', how='inner'
    )
    items = items[items['ts'] <= seed_time].copy()

    # Delivery info known at seed_time only if already delivered
    items['delivered'] = items['order_delivered_customer_date'].notna() & \
                         (items['order_delivered_customer_date'] <= seed_time)
    items['delivered_carrier'] = items['order_delivered_carrier_date'].notna() & \
                                 (items['order_delivered_carrier_date'] <= seed_time)
    items['delivery_delay'] = np.where(
        items['delivered'],
        (items['order_delivered_customer_date'] - items['order_estimated_delivery_date']).dt.days,
        np.nan
    )
    items['delivery_duration'] = np.where(
        items['delivered'],
        (items['order_delivered_customer_date'] - items['ts']).dt.days,
        np.nan
    )

    result = pd.DataFrame(index=pd.Index(entity_ids, name='product_id'))

    # ---- Base aggregations over full history up to seed_time ----
    grp = items.groupby('product_id')

    result['total_items'] = grp.size().reindex(entity_ids).fillna(0)
    result['total_orders'] = grp['order_id'].nunique().reindex(entity_ids).fillna(0)

    result['sum_price'] = grp['price'].sum().reindex(entity_ids).fillna(0)
    result['mean_price'] = grp['price'].mean().reindex(entity_ids).fillna(0)
    result['min_price'] = grp['price'].min().reindex(entity_ids).fillna(0)
    result['max_price'] = grp['price'].max().reindex(entity_ids).fillna(0)
    result['std_price'] = grp['price'].std().reindex(entity_ids).fillna(0)

    result['sum_freight'] = grp['freight_value'].sum().reindex(entity_ids).fillna(0)
    result['mean_freight'] = grp['freight_value'].mean().reindex(entity_ids).fillna(0)
    result['std_freight'] = grp['freight_value'].std().reindex(entity_ids).fillna(0)
    result['mean_freight_ratio'] = grp['freight_value'].sum().reindex(entity_ids).fillna(0) / \
                                   grp['price'].sum().reindex(entity_ids).replace(0, np.nan).fillna(1)

    result['unique_customers'] = grp['customer_id'].nunique().reindex(entity_ids).fillna(0)
    result['unique_sellers'] = grp['seller_id'].nunique().reindex(entity_ids).fillna(0)

    first_purchase = grp['ts'].min()
    last_purchase = grp['ts'].max()
    result['days_since_first'] = (seed_time - first_purchase).dt.days.reindex(entity_ids).fillna(0)
    result['days_since_last'] = (seed_time - last_purchase).dt.days.reindex(entity_ids).fillna(0)
    result['purchase_span_days'] = (last_purchase - first_purchase).dt.days.reindex(entity_ids).fillna(0)

    # interval features
    unique_events = items[['product_id', 'order_id', 'ts']].drop_duplicates(
        subset=['product_id', 'order_id']
    ).sort_values(['product_id', 'ts'])
    unique_events['prev_ts'] = unique_events.groupby('product_id')['ts'].shift()
    unique_events['interval_days'] = (unique_events['ts'] - unique_events['prev_ts']).dt.days

    result['avg_purchase_interval'] = unique_events.groupby('product_id')['interval_days'].mean()\
        .reindex(entity_ids).fillna(0)
    result['min_purchase_interval'] = unique_events.groupby('product_id')['interval_days'].min()\
        .reindex(entity_ids).fillna(0)
    result['max_purchase_interval'] = unique_events.groupby('product_id')['interval_days'].max()\
        .reindex(entity_ids).fillna(0)
    result['unique_purchase_dates'] = unique_events.groupby('product_id')['ts'].nunique()\
        .reindex(entity_ids).fillna(0)

    # delivery features (leak-safe)
    result['delivered_ratio'] = grp['delivered'].mean().reindex(entity_ids).fillna(0)
    result['mean_delivery_delay'] = grp['delivery_delay'].mean().reindex(entity_ids).fillna(0)
    result['mean_delivery_duration'] = grp['delivery_duration'].mean().reindex(entity_ids).fillna(0)

    # ---- Rolling windows (90 / 180 days) ----
    for w in (90, 180):
        witems = items[items['ts'] > seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=w)]
        wgrp = witems.groupby('product_id')
        result[f'items_{w}d'] = wgrp.size().reindex(entity_ids).fillna(0)
        result[f'orders_{w}d'] = wgrp['order_id'].nunique().reindex(entity_ids).fillna(0)
        result[f'mean_price_{w}d'] = wgrp['price'].mean().reindex(entity_ids).fillna(0)
        result[f'unique_sellers_{w}d'] = wgrp['seller_id'].nunique().reindex(entity_ids).fillna(0)

    # ---- Reviews: only those already written before seed_time ----
    rev_ok = reviews[reviews['review_creation_date'] <= seed_time][['order_id', 'review_score']]
    if len(items) > 0 and len(rev_ok) > 0:
        rev_merged = items[['order_id', 'product_id']].merge(rev_ok, on='order_id', how='inner')
    else:
        rev_merged = pd.DataFrame(columns=['order_id', 'product_id', 'review_score'])
    if not rev_merged.empty:
        rev_grp = rev_merged.groupby('product_id')['review_score']
        result['avg_review_score'] = rev_grp.mean().reindex(entity_ids).fillna(0)
        result['count_reviews'] = rev_grp.count().reindex(entity_ids).fillna(0)
        result['std_review_score'] = rev_grp.std().reindex(entity_ids).fillna(0)
        result['min_review_score'] = rev_grp.min().reindex(entity_ids).fillna(0)
        result['max_review_score'] = rev_grp.max().reindex(entity_ids).fillna(0)
        result['bad_review_ratio'] = rev_merged.assign(
            bad=(rev_merged['review_score'] <= 2).astype(float)
        ).groupby('product_id')['bad'].mean().reindex(entity_ids).fillna(0)
    else:
        for c in ['avg_review_score', 'count_reviews', 'std_review_score',
                  'min_review_score', 'max_review_score', 'bad_review_ratio']:
            result[c] = 0.0

    # ---- Payments: payment is attached to the order at purchase time; ts <= seed_time already ensured ----
    if len(items) > 0 and len(payments) > 0:
        pay_merged = items[['order_id', 'product_id']].merge(
            payments[['order_id', 'payment_installments', 'payment_type']],
            on='order_id', how='inner'
        )
    else:
        pay_merged = pd.DataFrame(columns=['order_id', 'product_id',
                                           'payment_installments', 'payment_type'])
    if not pay_merged.empty:
        result['total_payments'] = pay_merged.groupby('product_id').size()\
            .reindex(entity_ids).fillna(0)
        result['mean_installments'] = pay_merged.groupby('product_id')['payment_installments']\
            .mean().reindex(entity_ids).fillna(0)
        credit = pay_merged.assign(
            is_credit=(pay_merged['payment_type'] == 'credit_card').astype(float)
        )
        result['credit_card_ratio'] = credit.groupby('product_id')['is_credit'].mean()\
            .reindex(entity_ids).fillna(0)
    else:
        result['total_payments'] = 0.0
        result['mean_installments'] = 0.0
        result['credit_card_ratio'] = 0.0

    result = result.astype(float)
    result = result.reindex(pd.Index(entity_ids, name='product_id')).fillna(0)
    return result
